Which $$g(\vec{	heta})$$ is best for feature selection (i.e., eliminating irrelevant features and keeping useful ones)? Note: $$p$$ is the total number of parameters in $$\vec{	heta}$$. $$
$$ $$
$$ $$•$$ $$g(\vec{	heta}) $$=$$ \sum_{i=1}**{p} \log(	heta_i)$$
• $$g(\vec{	heta}) $$=$$ \sum_{i=1}**{p} $$	heta_i$$
• $$g(\vec{	heta}) $$=$$ \sum_{i=1}**{p} |	heta_i|$$
• $$g(\vec{	heta}) $$=$$ \sum_{i=1}**{p} 	heta_i**{2}$$
